staff.name: Major Applewhite
staff.record: 2024: 7-6 with a Salute to Veterans Bowl win. 2025: 4-8.
staff.note: A 28-26 loss at Louisiana, after a failed two-point try and a late interception, makes it three straight losses and 4-5. A bowl now needs all three left: Troy, at Southern Miss, App State. Bishop Davenport started at quarterback with no public reason given. Year three after a 4-8 season is when Sun Belt schools have moved on (Bowden at ULM, Beck at Coastal).

staff.name: Todd Orlando
staff.record: FBS coordinator since 2005 (Texas, USC, Houston, USF).
staff.note: The defense allows 32.2 points a game. Louisiana ran 44 times for 312 yards and converted 8 of 13 third downs, though a Jaylen Moson pick-six kept it close. That makes a move up unlikely this winter, and his future is tied to Applewhite: a head coaching change usually turns over the staff.

staff.name: Jason Washington
staff.note: Kept through the 2026 staff overhaul and given the co-coordinator title, a sign the head coach wants him. The pass defense held Louisiana to 147 yards on 14 attempts, with Moson returning an interception 72 yards for a TD. Unlikely to leave on his own.

staff.name: Richie Riley
staff.record: 152-106. 2024-25 Sun Belt regular-season title and NIT. 2025-26: 21-11.
staff.note: Eight straight seasons at .500 or better and two 20-win years in a row. The new extension makes him hard to pry loose, but a title-winning mid-major coach draws calls every March. A rebuilt roster (10 newcomers) is this season's test.

history.summary: Since the 2022 season, 13 Sun Belt football head coaching jobs have opened: 8 when a coach was hired away and 5 when a coach was fired or pushed out. Winners leave (Cignetti, Sumrall, Chadwell, Chesney); coaches who are fired had at least three seasons first.
